wand.title: Feather wand
wand.intro: Drag the feather around the screen. Pull it away from your kitty, like a little mouse running off — that's what cats love to chase.
wand.tip: Don't wave it right in front of your kitty's face. When it pounces, pull the feather away quickly!

wand.crouching: Your kitty is getting ready to pounce …
wand.catching: It's about to catch the feather …
wand.caught: Got it! Your kitty caught the feather.
wand.feedbackToward: Pull it away from your kitty, not towards its face.
wand.pullAwayA11y: Pull the feather away from your kitty
wand.stageA11y: Play area: your kitty and a feather on a wand. Drag the feather away from it.

result.success: Your kitty played and caught the feather. This game counts for today.

reasons.too_few_moves: The feather needs to run away more often — pull it away many times during the minute.
reasons.not_spread: Keep the feather moving the whole minute, not just for a part of it.
reasons.wrong_technique: Pull the feather away from your kitty, like a mouse running off — not into its face.
reasons.missed_pounces: When your kitty pounces, pull the feather away quickly.
reasons.too_uniform: Move the feather your own way — little stops and starts make the game fun.

grooming.title: Brush your kitty
grooming.intro: Brush its long fur gently with your finger, stroke after stroke, from head to tail.

litter_change.title: Change all the litter
litter_change.intro: Once a week all the litter goes out: empty the box, wash it and fill it with fresh litter. Scrub with your finger.
litter_change.weekDone: This week's litter change is done ✓
litter_change.weekOpen: Change the litter {{when}} at the latest.
litter_change.overdue: Last week's change was missed, so the box smells — scoop quickly until you change it.
litter_change.stageA11y: The litter box. Scrub it with your finger.

result.success: All the litter is fresh. This week's change is done.

reasons.too_few_strokes: A few more strokes next time — keep going until the time is up.
reasons.not_spread: Keep going through all three steps, right to the end.
reasons.too_uniform: Stroke your own way — a little faster, a little slower.

scratching.title: To the scratching post
scratching.intro: Your kitty scratched the sofa. It isn't naughty — cats need to scratch. Carry it to its scratching post and praise it right away when it scratches the post.
scratching.never: Never shout or punish — just show it the right place and praise it.
scratching.nothing: Your kitty hasn't scratched anything. All good!
scratching.dueAt: Show it the scratching post {{when}} at the latest.

reasons.too_early: A little early — praise it when it's scratching the post.
reasons.too_late: A little late — praise it right when it scratches the post.
reasons.no_praise: It scratched the post — praise it next time!

firstAid.title: Good to know
firstAid.body: A real cat must never go without food for long. If a cat stops eating, it needs to see a vet soon.

contract.bodyMaineCoon:
I promise to take good care of my virtual kitty, every single day:

• I will feed it at the right time.
• I will give it fresh water every day.
• I will clean its litter box every day and change all the litter once a week.
• I will play with it every day so it stays healthy and happy.
• I will brush it regularly so its fur doesn't get knotted.
• I will act on warnings before it gets sick or has to go to the virtual shelter.

Do you accept this responsibility?

firstAid.title: Good to know
firstAid.body: For a real cat, not eating is serious: a cat that stops eating can develop a dangerous liver disease (hepatic lipidosis). If a cat stops eating, contact a vet promptly — don't wait.
